bar.signalroutes.tooltip: Signal routes: the routes of the rail signals and the track each one clears. Click a route to show it on the map.
sigroute.empty: This map has no signal routes.
sigroute.empty.hint: Signal routes (signalroutes.cfg) tell trains and trams which track a signal clears. Maps without rail signals do not need them.
sigroute.summary: {count, plural, one {# route} other {# routes}} at {signals, plural, one {# signal} other {# signals}}
sigroute.file_problems: signalroutes.cfg has {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} that belong to no route. Hover for details.
sigroute.filter.tooltip: Showing only the routes of this signal. Click to show all routes.
sigroute.row.tooltip: Show this route on the map: its track pieces and signals.
sigroute.row.pieces: {count, plural, one {# track piece} other {# track pieces}}
sigroute.detail.track: {found, number} of {count, number} track pieces found on the map
sigroute.status.selected: Route {number}: {count, plural, one {# track piece} other {# track pieces}}, {found, number} found on the map.
sigroute.status.failed: Could not read the signal routes: {reason}
sigroute.edited.tooltip: This route differs from the original map.
sigroute.edit.kind.tooltip: The kind number of the route, a whole number from 0.
sigroute.edit.aspect.tooltip: What the signal shows when this route is set. A speed limit sets reduced speed, no limit sets proceed.
sigroute.edit.aspect.other: Aspect {aspect} comes from another map or program. It stays as it is until you choose one of these.
sigroute.edit.distant.tooltip: The ID of the signal that announces this route. Leave empty for none.
sigroute.edit.next.tooltip: The ID of the signal that follows this route. Leave empty for none.
sigroute.edit.speed.tooltip: The speed limit of the route in km/h. Leave empty for no limit.
sigroute.edit.remove.tooltip: Take this signal out of the route.
sigroute.edit.pick.tooltip: Click a signal on the map to use its ID. Esc stops.
sigroute.edit.delete.tooltip: Take this route out of signalroutes.cfg. Undo brings it back.
sigroute.delete.title: Delete route {number}?
sigroute.delete.text: The route is taken out of signalroutes.cfg. Its track pieces and signals can be deleted afterwards. Undo brings the route back.
sigroute.status.pick_distant: Click a signal on the map to make it the distant signal of route {number}. Esc stops.
sigroute.status.pick_next: Click a signal on the map to make it the next signal of route {number}. Esc stops.
sigroute.status.pick_ended: Picking stopped. The route stays as it is.
sigroute.status.edited: Route {number} changed. Undo takes it back.
sigroute.status.deleted: Route {number} deleted. Undo brings it back.
sigroute.status.bad_kind: The kind is a whole number, 0 or more.
sigroute.status.bad_id: Enter the ID of a signal on the map, or leave the field empty.
sigroute.status.bad_speed: Enter a speed in km/h above 0, or leave the field empty for no limit.
